name: CF-337 Panther "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
description:
Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner
Item Type: Laser Repeater
Size: 3

The CF-337 Panther is the size three model in Klaus & Werner's laser repeater line. The Panther is a true fire-and-forget weapon with a respectable power consumption-to-damage ratio. Pilots who outfit their ships with Panthers rarely regret the decision. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.
